description: This source file defines the GZIPResponseStream class, which extends ServletOutputStream to provide GZIP compression functionalities for HTTP responses in a web application, specifically used within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: GZIPResponseStream
classes.description: A ServletOutputStream implementation that compresses data using GZIP before sending it to the client, used for response compression in web applications.

methods.name: GZIPResponseStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GZIPResponseStream with the HttpServletResponse object and sets up buffering.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the output stream, compresses buffered data if needed, and sets appropriate headers.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a byte or byte array to the buffered output stream, handling buffer size checks.

methods.name: checkBufferSize
methods.description: Checks if the buffer exceeds the predefined size and switches to GZIP streaming if necessary.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is ready for writing; not supported asynchronously.

methods.name: setWriteListener
methods.description: Sets a WriteListener for asynchronous writing; not supported.

methods.name: closed
methods.description: Returns whether the stream has been closed.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reset method, no operation in this implementation.
